3899-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3899-5254-6774.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

1479-2692-2841-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2692-2841-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1558-2638-3756-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3756-4231-7810.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3457-5709-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
3457-5709-7791.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Rofellos.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Rofellos.
Repeat.

1368-1563-4742-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-4742-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4068-4149-4599-4871-6019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

1251-3259-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
1251-3259-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-5733-7431.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-5733-7431.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

856-2099-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1558-3129-3756-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3129-3756-3875-4231.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

6798-7084-7201.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2894-3595-6033-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2894-3595-6033-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Shambling Shell. Then, the draw will be replaced by Shambling Shell's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Shambling Shell from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4002-4331-4993-6556.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-6556.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1315-3215-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

539-6797-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

539-6797-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5078-6289-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-3129-5220-5631-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-5631-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-4853-5231.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Repeat.

4613-4968-5427-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Tor Wauki the Younger.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2099-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2099-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1741-2092-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1741-2092-5900.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1818-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1818-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1379-1651-3459-3685-4497.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
1379-1651-3459-3685-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding {7} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Battered Golem.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger, destroying target permanent.
Resolve the Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and Spine of Ish Sah, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3676-3771-5125.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
392-3676-3771-5125.description:
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {R}{G}.
Birgi, Animar and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot and Birgi triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster trigger, dealing 1 damage to any player or planeswalker.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3432-3901.description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers for each Dragon you control.
Resolve the first Wrathful Red Dragon trigger, dealing 20 damage to any non-Dragon target.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.

1156-2034-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Pia and Kiran.
Pia and Kiran enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Thopter creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the two Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
